units.rawText: De Lacey, pull back!
units.displayText: De Lacey, pull back!

spans.text: De Lacey, pull back!

units.rawText:
As if responding to the sound of his voice, the pavement De Lacey was standing on abruptly disintegrated.
Myriad chains blasted forth, expelled from fissures in the very earth itself, bringing remnant shadows.

units.rawText: Two silhouettes, black and white, descended from high above, visiting solemnity and quietude upon the land.
units.displayText: Two silhouettes, black and white, descended from high above, visiting solemnity and quietude upon the land.

spans.text: Two silhouettes, black and white, descended from high above, visiting solemnity and quietude upon the land.

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower Tribunal therefore takes into its jurisdiction the case of the Ascension Sector's Security Management Vulnerabilities and henceforth shall hold a public hearing in accordance with legislation.
units.displayText: The Reverse Babylon Tower Tribunal therefore takes into its jurisdiction the case of the Ascension Sector's Security Management Vulnerabilities and henceforth shall hold a public hearing in accordance with legislation.

spans.text: The Reverse Babylon Tower Tribunal therefore takes into its jurisdiction the case of the Ascension Sector's Security Management Vulnerabilities and henceforth shall hold a public hearing in accordance with legislation.

units.rawText: Intermediate Sanctifier "Crime" shall serve as presiding judge and Intermediate Sanctifier "Punishment" as head executioner. Unassociated individuals are advised to vacate the area. Thus it shall be.
units.displayText: Intermediate Sanctifier "Crime" shall serve as presiding judge and Intermediate Sanctifier "Punishment" as head executioner. Unassociated individuals are advised to vacate the area. Thus it shall be.

spans.text: Intermediate Sanctifier "Crime" shall serve as presiding judge and Intermediate Sanctifier "Punishment" as head executioner. Unassociated individuals are advised to vacate the area. Thus it shall be.

units.rawText: A tranquil voice rang out within the ears of all present, temperate in its intonation.
units.displayText: A tranquil voice rang out within the ears of all present, temperate in its intonation.

spans.text: A tranquil voice rang out within the ears of all present, temperate in its intonation.

units.rawText: The iron dome composed of chains took the Admin Center as its core, sketching out a circular field, forbidding all that is outside from entry.
units.displayText: The iron dome composed of chains took the Admin Center as its core, sketching out a circular field, forbidding all that is outside from entry.

spans.text: The iron dome composed of chains took the Admin Center as its core, sketching out a circular field, forbidding all that is outside from entry.

units.rawText: ...This kinda presence, and it's not even a Greater Sanctifier...
units.displayText: ...This kinda presence, and it's not even a Greater Sanctifier...

spans.text: ...This kinda presence, and it's not even a Greater Sanctifier...

units.rawText: De Lacey! Are you ok?
units.displayText: De Lacey! Are you ok?

spans.text: De Lacey! Are you ok?

units.rawText: I'm fine. Good call, Suu.
units.displayText: I'm fine. Good call, Suu.

spans.text: I'm fine. Good call, Suu.

units.rawText: I was underground, so I felt those chains coming early.
units.displayText: I was underground, so I felt those chains coming early.

spans.text: I was underground, so I felt those chains coming early.

units.rawText: It's just that since these chains came from below ground, I won't be able to get through this barrier by going underground.
units.displayText: It's just that since these chains came from below ground, I won't be able to get through this barrier by going underground.

spans.text: It's just that since these chains came from below ground, I won't be able to get through this barrier by going underground.

units.rawText: Special Intermediates, "Crime" and "Punishment"... Boss mentioned these names before.
units.displayText: Special Intermediates, "Crime" and "Punishment"... Boss mentioned these names before.

spans.text: Special Intermediates, "Crime" and "Punishment"... Boss mentioned these names before.

units.rawText: Never thought that we'd run into them at this time, and they brought such a big lockdown area with them.
units.displayText: Never thought that we'd run into them at this time, and they brought such a big lockdown area with them.

spans.text: Never thought that we'd run into them at this time, and they brought such a big lockdown area with them.

units.rawText: But this isn't the time to chitchat. Lind's still in there!
units.displayText: But this isn't the time to chitchat. Lind's still in there!

spans.text: But this isn't the time to chitchat. Lind's still in there!

units.rawText: Sueyoi took another vigilant glance at the stationary Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Sueyoi took another vigilant glance at the stationary Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Sueyoi took another vigilant glance at the stationary Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Don't know what's going on exactly, but they seem to have been ordered to stop attacking.
units.displayText: Don't know what's going on exactly, but they seem to have been ordered to stop attacking.

spans.text: Don't know what's going on exactly, but they seem to have been ordered to stop attacking.

units.rawText: Be careful. Get out of dodge if something seems off.
units.displayText: Be careful. Get out of dodge if something seems off.

spans.text: Be careful. Get out of dodge if something seems off.

units.rawText: ...Got it. Take care.
units.displayText: ...Got it. Take care.

spans.text: ...Got it. Take care.

units.rawText: Sueyoi exhaled in a drawn-out manner. Keeping a wary eye on the Sanctifiers still behind him, he tested the waters with the iron barrier.
units.displayText: Sueyoi exhaled in a drawn-out manner. Keeping a wary eye on the Sanctifiers still behind him, he tested the waters with the iron barrier.

spans.text: Sueyoi exhaled in a drawn-out manner. Keeping a wary eye on the Sanctifiers still behind him, he tested the waters with the iron barrier.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: Punishment, something's trying to break through my blockade.
units.displayText: Punishment, something's trying to break through my blockade.

spans.text: Punishment, something's trying to break through my blockade.

units.rawText: Those agents? Don't mind it. The blockade's only a formality.
units.displayText: Those agents? Don't mind it. The blockade's only a formality.

spans.text: Those agents? Don't mind it. The blockade's only a formality.

units.rawText: Let's get the job done, Crime.
units.displayText: Let's get the job done, Crime.

spans.text: Let's get the job done, Crime.

units.rawText: The Admin Center's doors opened in their entirety. Elaugh, alone, came forth.
units.displayText: The Admin Center's doors opened in their entirety. Elaugh, alone, came forth.

spans.text: The Admin Center's doors opened in their entirety. Elaugh, alone, came forth.

units.rawText: I was not expecting you for another few months.
units.displayText: I was not expecting you for another few months.

spans.text: I was not expecting you for another few months.

units.rawText: No matter how many times I am forced to deal with you, your conceit never fails to surprise.
units.displayText: No matter how many times I am forced to deal with you, your conceit never fails to surprise.

spans.text: No matter how many times I am forced to deal with you, your conceit never fails to surprise.

units.rawText: Everyone is in attendance. Crime, open the court.
units.displayText: Everyone is in attendance. Crime, open the court.

spans.text: Everyone is in attendance. Crime, open the court.

units.rawText: Oh, me? You see, that declaration earlier already took all the strength out of me.
units.displayText: Oh, me? You see, that declaration earlier already took all the strength out of me.

spans.text: Oh, me? You see, that declaration earlier already took all the strength out of me.

units.rawText: I don't wanna take the role of the jury...
units.displayText: I don't wanna take the role of the jury...

spans.text: I don't wanna take the role of the jury...

units.rawText: Punishment lightly slapped at Crime's midsection with the hilt of their weapon.
units.displayText: Punishment lightly slapped at Crime's midsection with the hilt of their weapon.

spans.text: Punishment lightly slapped at Crime's midsection with the hilt of their weapon.

units.rawText: Did I give you a choice, Crime?
units.displayText: Did I give you a choice, Crime?

spans.text: Did I give you a choice, Crime?

units.rawText: ...Alright, fine.
units.displayText: ...Alright, fine.

spans.text: ...Alright, fine.

units.rawText: Crime sighed, rising to full height and facing Elaugh directly.
units.displayText: Crime sighed, rising to full height and facing Elaugh directly.

spans.text: Crime sighed, rising to full height and facing Elaugh directly.

units.rawText: You know for what reason we are here. The Reverse Babylon Tower has given the Ascension Sector courtesy enough.
units.displayText: You know for what reason we are here. The Reverse Babylon Tower has given the Ascension Sector courtesy enough.

spans.text: You know for what reason we are here. The Reverse Babylon Tower has given the Ascension Sector courtesy enough.

units.rawText: Cease this chillul hashem, halt the operation of your Production Rooms, and submit the Seed of Calamity for judgment.
units.displayText: Cease this chillul hashem, halt the operation of your Production Rooms, and submit the Seed of Calamity for judgment.

spans.text: Cease this chillul hashem, halt the operation of your Production Rooms, and submit the Seed of Calamity for judgment.

units.rawText: I do not understand your words. Seed of Calamity... do you perhaps mean those prosthetic molds in the factories?
units.displayText: I do not understand your words. Seed of Calamity... do you perhaps mean those prosthetic molds in the factories?

spans.text: I do not understand your words. Seed of Calamity... do you perhaps mean those prosthetic molds in the factories?

units.rawText: Your attempts at beguilement are cause for laughter, Elaugh. Do you think it's the first time we have visited Ascension?
units.displayText: Your attempts at beguilement are cause for laughter, Elaugh. Do you think it's the first time we have visited Ascension?

spans.text: Your attempts at beguilement are cause for laughter, Elaugh. Do you think it's the first time we have visited Ascension?

units.rawText: The production of prosthetics is what the Ascension Sector is designated for, and is also the order of the humans. The Sanctifiers should have no jurisdiction over this.
units.displayText: The production of prosthetics is what the Ascension Sector is designated for, and is also the order of the humans. The Sanctifiers should have no jurisdiction over this.

spans.text: The production of prosthetics is what the Ascension Sector is designated for, and is also the order of the humans. The Sanctifiers should have no jurisdiction over this.

units.rawText: ...Sigh. I'm really not one for this back-and-forth.
units.displayText: ...Sigh. I'm really not one for this back-and-forth.

spans.text: ...Sigh. I'm really not one for this back-and-forth.

units.rawText: You should think well what words you choose for this occasion.
units.displayText: You should think well what words you choose for this occasion.

spans.text: You should think well what words you choose for this occasion.

units.rawText: Sigh... Elaugh, I had hoped that you'd be more governable than your predecessor.
units.displayText: Sigh... Elaugh, I had hoped that you'd be more governable than your predecessor.

spans.text: Sigh... Elaugh, I had hoped that you'd be more governable than your predecessor.

units.rawText: After the many chats we've had, it'd take formidable effort to not figure out what you're producing in those factories.
units.displayText: After the many chats we've had, it'd take formidable effort to not figure out what you're producing in those factories.

spans.text: After the many chats we've had, it'd take formidable effort to not figure out what you're producing in those factories.

units.rawText: Nothing more to say?
units.displayText: Nothing more to say?

spans.text: Nothing more to say?

units.rawText: No, I am merely contemplating by what authority you refer to her like that by. The virtue of the name bestowed upon you by that unenlightened tower of yours?
units.displayText: No, I am merely contemplating by what authority you refer to her like that by. The virtue of the name bestowed upon you by that unenlightened tower of yours?

spans.text: No, I am merely contemplating by what authority you refer to her like that by. The virtue of the name bestowed upon you by that unenlightened tower of yours?

units.rawText: Crime... Punishment... what grand syllables for existences not even human.
units.displayText: Crime... Punishment... what grand syllables for existences not even human.

spans.text: Crime... Punishment... what grand syllables for existences not even human.

units.rawText: And my "predecessor"... a term as narcissistic as your titles. You should, by all rights, refer to Avram as the Ascension Sector's precursor, Magrasea's helmsman.
units.displayText: And my "predecessor"... a term as narcissistic as your titles. You should, by all rights, refer to Avram as the Ascension Sector's precursor, Magrasea's helmsman.

spans.text: And my "predecessor"... a term as narcissistic as your titles. You should, by all rights, refer to Avram as the Ascension Sector's precursor, Magrasea's helmsman.

units.rawText: Desecrating, tarnishing, and defaming the name of the Reverse Babylon Tower is also a severe transgression. Do not force my hand in stripping you of your administrative rights!
units.displayText: Desecrating, tarnishing, and defaming the name of the Reverse Babylon Tower is also a severe transgression. Do not force my hand in stripping you of your administrative rights!

spans.text: Desecrating, tarnishing, and defaming the name of the Reverse Babylon Tower is also a severe transgression. Do not force my hand in stripping you of your administrative rights!

units.rawText: Stripping? Where does your confidence come from?
units.displayText: Stripping? Where does your confidence come from?

spans.text: Stripping? Where does your confidence come from?

units.rawText: End of interrogation. No admissions from her.
units.displayText: End of interrogation. No admissions from her.

spans.text: End of interrogation. No admissions from her.

units.rawText: Punishment brandished her scythe, turning towards Elaugh.
units.displayText: Punishment brandished her scythe, turning towards Elaugh.

spans.text: Punishment brandished her scythe, turning towards Elaugh.

units.rawText: I hope to see that same backbone in you when your administrative rights are peeled from your core.
units.displayText: I hope to see that same backbone in you when your administrative rights are peeled from your core.

spans.text: I hope to see that same backbone in you when your administrative rights are peeled from your core.

units.rawText: Peel this, core that. You've been an aberration to my mind ever since I first laid eyes on you.
units.displayText: Peel this, core that. You've been an aberration to my mind ever since I first laid eyes on you.

spans.text: Peel this, core that. You've been an aberration to my mind ever since I first laid eyes on you.

units.rawText: Punishment stared intently at Elaugh, pupils suddenly narrowing.
units.displayText: Punishment stared intently at Elaugh, pupils suddenly narrowing.

spans.text: Punishment stared intently at Elaugh, pupils suddenly narrowing.

units.rawText: Hehe... I like that answer! You're a bit firmer than last time.
units.displayText: Hehe... I like that answer! You're a bit firmer than last time.

spans.text: Hehe... I like that answer! You're a bit firmer than last time.

units.rawText: It is exactly the presence of perverse and insolent agents like you that gives cause for the Tribunal's existence.
units.displayText: It is exactly the presence of perverse and insolent agents like you that gives cause for the Tribunal's existence.

spans.text: It is exactly the presence of perverse and insolent agents like you that gives cause for the Tribunal's existence.

units.rawText: Elaugh's not one to reverse her position on a whim. She must have a card up her sleeve... sigh, I'm not feeling like fighting.
units.displayText: Elaugh's not one to reverse her position on a whim. She must have a card up her sleeve... sigh, I'm not feeling like fighting.

spans.text: Elaugh's not one to reverse her position on a whim. She must have a card up her sleeve... sigh, I'm not feeling like fighting.

units.rawText: No matter what it is, I can tear it apart.
units.displayText: No matter what it is, I can tear it apart.

spans.text: No matter what it is, I can tear it apart.

units.rawText: Condemnation is your obligation. Take up the mantle, and fulfil it!
units.displayText: Condemnation is your obligation. Take up the mantle, and fulfil it!

spans.text: Condemnation is your obligation. Take up the mantle, and fulfil it!

units.rawText: Sigh... alright.
units.displayText: Sigh... alright.

spans.text: Sigh... alright.

units.rawText: Crime erased his lackadaisical attitude, projecting his voice toward the skies once more.
units.displayText: Crime erased his lackadaisical attitude, projecting his voice toward the skies once more.

spans.text: Crime erased his lackadaisical attitude, projecting his voice toward the skies once more.

units.rawText: Take heed—Elaugh, in charge of the Ascension Sector, has abused her position to create engines of blasphemy, concealing a Seed of Calamity, and poses a grave threat to Magrasea's security.
units.displayText: Take heed—Elaugh, in charge of the Ascension Sector, has abused her position to create engines of blasphemy, concealing a Seed of Calamity, and poses a grave threat to Magrasea's security.

spans.text: Take heed—Elaugh, in charge of the Ascension Sector, has abused her position to create engines of blasphemy, concealing a Seed of Calamity, and poses a grave threat to Magrasea's security.

units.rawText: Hereby constituting—<|> the crime of heresy!
units.displayText: Hereby constituting— the crime of heresy!

spans.text: Hereby constituting—
the crime of heresy!

units.rawText: Punishment strode forth in accord, chain-encased sickle wailing.
units.displayText: Punishment strode forth in accord, chain-encased sickle wailing.

spans.text: Punishment strode forth in accord, chain-encased sickle wailing.

units.rawText: <size=40>Evildoers shall be chastised!</size>
units.displayText: Evildoers shall be chastised!

spans.text: Evildoers shall be chastised!

units.rawText: Casting a grim shadow, the scythe descended, its honed edge seemingly separating the very connection between Elaugh and the sector.
units.displayText: Casting a grim shadow, the scythe descended, its honed edge seemingly separating the very connection between Elaugh and the sector.

spans.text: Casting a grim shadow, the scythe descended, its honed edge seemingly separating the very connection between Elaugh and the sector.

units.rawText: <size=40>Clang—!</size>
units.displayText: Clang—!

spans.text: Clang—!

units.rawText: The future one might have envisioned did not come to be. Elaugh only grunted, involuntarily taking two steps back.
units.displayText: The future one might have envisioned did not come to be. Elaugh only grunted, involuntarily taking two steps back.

spans.text: The future one might have envisioned did not come to be. Elaugh only grunted, involuntarily taking two steps back.

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: They're not cut, her Rights... are elsewhere?
units.displayText: They're not cut, her Rights... are elsewhere?

spans.text: They're not cut, her Rights... are elsewhere?

units.rawText: Ignorant fool.
units.displayText: Ignorant fool.

spans.text: Ignorant fool.

units.rawText: Elaugh pressed down on the core of her body, operands surging, flowing towards unknown ends.
units.displayText: Elaugh pressed down on the core of her body, operands surging, flowing towards unknown ends.

spans.text: Elaugh pressed down on the core of her body, operands surging, flowing towards unknown ends.

units.rawText: She's connected to something somewhere...
units.displayText: She's connected to something somewhere...

spans.text: She's connected to something somewhere...

units.rawText: Hmph, no matter. We shall cleave it apart like always.
units.displayText: Hmph, no matter. We shall cleave it apart like always.

spans.text: Hmph, no matter. We shall cleave it apart like always.

units.rawText: Operand density is rising. There's a giant agent attempting to break through my blockade.
units.displayText: Operand density is rising. There's a giant agent attempting to break through my blockade.

spans.text: Operand density is rising. There's a giant agent attempting to break through my blockade.

units.rawText: The one from before?
units.displayText: The one from before?

spans.text: The one from before?

units.rawText: No, far stronger and in a different direction... it's coming from inside the blockade!
units.displayText: No, far stronger and in a different direction... it's coming from inside the blockade!

spans.text: No, far stronger and in a different direction... it's coming from inside the blockade!

units.rawText: While the two stood bewildered, Elaugh discreetly backed behind the doors of the Admin Center, laughing ominously.
units.displayText: While the two stood bewildered, Elaugh discreetly backed behind the doors of the Admin Center, laughing ominously.

spans.text: While the two stood bewildered, Elaugh discreetly backed behind the doors of the Admin Center, laughing ominously.

units.rawText: As I said, you are not suited to judge her. It is you who should be subject to judgment.
units.displayText: As I said, you are not suited to judge her. It is you who should be subject to judgment.

spans.text: As I said, you are not suited to judge her. It is you who should be subject to judgment.

units.rawText: <size=50>No escape!</size>
units.displayText: No escape!

spans.text: No escape!

units.rawText: <color=orange>Witness the dawn of a new age, an ark with no foothold for the Sanctifiers!</color>
units.displayText: Witness the dawn of a new age, an ark with no foothold for the Sanctifiers!

spans.text: Witness the dawn of a new age, an ark with no foothold for the Sanctifiers!

units.rawText: The chain and scythe lagged a step behind in their dance, failing to find their mark before the closing of those doors.
units.displayText: The chain and scythe lagged a step behind in their dance, failing to find their mark before the closing of those doors.

spans.text: The chain and scythe lagged a step behind in their dance, failing to find their mark before the closing of those doors.

units.rawText: Clang—!
units.displayText: Clang—!

spans.text: Clang—!

units.rawText: Under Sueyoi's constant attacks, the iron curtain finally began to show cracks.
units.displayText: Under Sueyoi's constant attacks, the iron curtain finally began to show cracks.

spans.text: Under Sueyoi's constant attacks, the iron curtain finally began to show cracks.

units.rawText: Let's go, Suu! It's working! You'll be through in no time!
units.displayText: Let's go, Suu! It's working! You'll be through in no time!

spans.text: Let's go, Suu! It's working! You'll be through in no time!

units.rawText: Wasn't me.
units.displayText: Wasn't me.

spans.text: Wasn't me.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.displayText: Sueyoi retracted his weapon, the iron barrier now violently convulsing. In a flash it collapsed and crumbled, disappearing into fragments.

spans.text: Sueyoi retracted his weapon, the iron barrier now violently convulsing. In a flash it collapsed and crumbled, disappearing into fragments.

units.displayText: [Newest Commands confirmed, Ascension Sector Wide-area Purification authorized.]

spans.text: The piercing sound of shifting metal filled the air as the Sanctifiers began to move once more.

units.rawText: Pull back!
units.displayText: Pull back!

spans.text: Pull back!

units.rawText: [Priority Target—Daemon situated at the former Admin Center.]
units.displayText: [Priority Target—Daemon situated at the former Admin Center.]

spans.text: [Priority Target—Daemon situated at the former Admin Center.]

units.rawText: Daemon situated at the former Admin Center?
